events.verdict: Garland (LAC) establishes a screening position outside of Nesmith's (IND) field of view and gives him a step to avoid the contact.
Nesmith (IND) moves forward into Leonard's (LAC) path and initiates illegal body to body contact that affects his SQBR as the pick is set.
Lopez (LAC) slightly brings his forearm forward as he moves alongside Nembhard's (IND) path and marginal body contact occurs during the drive.
Toppin (IND) makes contact with the ball after it exits the imaginary cylinder above the rim.
Lopez (LAC) extends his arms to, not through, Toppin's (IND) space as they come together during the pick, and the contact is marginal.
Sheppard (IND) dislodges Garland (LAC) from his rebounding position, which affects his ability to secure the loose ball.
Jones Jr. (LAC) slightly steps forward as he contests the jump shot attempt and marginal contact occurs with Siakam's (IND) slightly extending right leg, prior to returning to the ground.
Nesmith (IND) legally contests Leonard's (LAC) jump shot attempt.
Nembhard's (IND) inbound pass does not touch another player prior to going into the basket.
Nesmith (IND) commits a take foul on Mathurin (LAC).
Lopez (LAC) extends his arms outward and delivers illegal body contact to Huff (IND) that affects his ability to get to the pass.
Lopez (LAC) and Toppin (IND) mutually engage and immediately disengage as marginal contact occurs during the rebound.
